answer: Deposits are visible in voyage, and inlet reconciles the forfeits at each close. A bond of 35% of expected earnings must sit in a custody account that the identity cannot spend from, only forfeit. Because the custody account is separate, someone cannot recycle one pool of capital across 167 aliases, and each one needs its own funded pearl account. Each duplicate costs another 50 dollars in locked collateral and another 5 days of waiting. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
